verses.original: הוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה כִּי־ ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י חַסְדּֽוֹ׃ לְעוֹלָ֣ם
verses.transliteration: hō·w·ḏū Yah·weh kî- ṭō·wḇ kî ḥas·dōw lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: Give thanks to the LORD for He is good . . . His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֖י יֹֽאמַר־ נָ֥א חַסְדּֽוֹ׃ לְעוֹלָ֣ם
verses.transliteration: yiś·rā·’êl kî yō·mar- nā ḥas·dōw lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: Let Israel . . . say . . . His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: בֵֽית־ אַהֲרֹ֑ן כִּ֖י יֹֽאמְרוּ־ נָ֥א חַסְדּֽוֹ׃ לְעוֹלָ֣ם
verses.transliteration: ḇêṯ- ’a·hă·rōn kî yō·mə·rū- nā ḥas·dōw lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: Let the house of Aaron . . . say . . . His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: יִרְאֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֖י יֹֽאמְרוּ־ נָ֭א חַסְדּֽוֹ׃ לְעוֹלָ֣ם
verses.transliteration: yir·’ê Yah·weh kî yō·mə·rū- nā ḥas·dōw lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: Let those who fear the LORD . . . say . . . His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: מִֽן־ הַ֭מֵּצַ֥ר קָרָ֣אתִי יָּ֑הּ יָֽהּ׃ עָנָ֖נִי בַמֶּרְחָ֣ב
verses.transliteration: min- ham·mê·ṣar qā·rā·ṯî yāh yāh ‘ā·nā·nî ḇam·mer·ḥāḇ
verses.literal: In [my] distress I called to the LORD [and He] answered [and set me] free

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה לִ֭י לֹ֣א אִירָ֑א מַה־ אָדָֽם׃ יַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה לִ֣י
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh lî lō ’î·rā mah- ’ā·ḏām ya·‘ă·śeh lî
verses.literal: The LORD [is] on my side I will not be afraid What can man do to me

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה לִ֭י בְּעֹזְרָ֑י וַ֝אֲנִ֗י אֶרְאֶ֥ה בְשֹׂנְאָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh lî bə·‘ō·zə·rāy wa·’ă·nî ’er·’eh ḇə·śō·nə·’āy
verses.literal: The LORD [is] on my side He is my helper Therefore I will look in triumph on those who hate me

verses.original: ט֗וֹב לַחֲס֥וֹת בַּיהוָ֑ה מִ֝בְּטֹ֗חַ בָּאָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ṭō·wḇ la·ḥă·sō·wṯ Yah·weh mib·bə·ṭō·aḥ bā·’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in man

verses.original: ט֗וֹב לַחֲס֥וֹת בַּיהוָ֑ה מִ֝בְּטֹ֗חַ בִּנְדִיבִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ṭō·wḇ la·ḥă·sō·wṯ Yah·weh mib·bə·ṭō·aḥ bin·ḏî·ḇîm
verses.literal: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in princes

verses.original: כָּל־ גּוֹיִ֥ם סְבָב֑וּנִי בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲמִילַֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- gō·w·yim sə·ḇā·ḇū·nî bə·šêm Yah·weh kî ’ă·mî·lam
verses.literal: All the nations surrounded me but in the name of the LORD vvv I cut them off

verses.original: סַבּ֥וּנִי גַם־ סְבָב֑וּנִי בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲמִילַֽם׃
verses.transliteration: sab·bū·nî ḡam- sə·ḇā·ḇū·nî bə·šêm Yah·weh kî ’ă·mî·lam
verses.literal: They surrounded me vvv on every side but in the name of the LORD vvv I cut them off

verses.original: סַבּ֤וּנִי כִדְבוֹרִ֗ים דֹּ֭עֲכוּ כְּאֵ֣שׁ קוֹצִ֑ים בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲמִילַֽם׃
verses.transliteration: sab·bū·nî ḵiḏ·ḇō·w·rîm dō·‘ă·ḵū kə·’êš qō·w·ṣîm bə·šêm Yah·weh kî ’ă·mî·lam
verses.literal: They swarmed around me like bees [but] they were extinguished like burning thorns in the name of the LORD vvv I cut them off

verses.original: דַּחֹ֣ה דְחִיתַ֣נִי לִנְפֹּ֑ל וַ֖יהוָ֣ה עֲזָרָֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: da·ḥōh ḏə·ḥî·ṯa·nî lin·pōl Yah·weh ‘ă·zā·rā·nî
verses.literal: I was pushed so hard . . . I was falling but the LORD helped me

verses.original: יָ֑הּ עָזִּ֣י וְזִמְרָ֣ת וַֽיְהִי־ לִ֝֗י לִֽישׁוּעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: yāh ‘āz·zî wə·zim·rāṯ way·hî- lî lî·šū·‘āh
verses.literal: The LORD is my strength and my song and He has become my salvation

verses.original: ק֤וֹל׀ רִנָּ֬ה וִֽישׁוּעָ֗ה בְּאָהֳלֵ֥י צַדִּיקִ֑ים יְמִ֥ין יְ֝הוָה עֹ֣שָׂה חָֽיִל׃
verses.transliteration: qō·wl rin·nāh wî·šū·‘āh bə·’ā·ho·lê ṣad·dî·qîm yə·mîn Yah·weh ‘ō·śāh ḥā·yil
verses.literal: Shouts of joy and salvation [resound] in the tents of the righteous The right hand of the LORD performs with valor

verses.original: יְמִ֣ין יְ֭הוָה רוֹמֵמָ֑ה יְמִ֥ין יְ֝הוָה עֹ֣שָׂה חָֽיִל׃
verses.transliteration: yə·mîn Yah·weh rō·w·mê·māh yə·mîn Yah·weh ‘ō·śāh ḥā·yil
verses.literal: The right hand of the LORD is exalted The right hand of the LORD performs with valor

verses.original: לֹֽא אָמ֥וּת כִּי־ אֶֽחְיֶ֑ה וַ֝אֲסַפֵּ֗ר יָֽהּ׃ מַֽעֲשֵׂ֥י
verses.transliteration: lō ’ā·mūṯ kî- ’eḥ·yeh wa·’ă·sap·pêr yāh ma·‘ă·śê
verses.literal: I will not die but I will live and proclaim what the LORD has done

verses.original: יָּ֑הּ יַסֹּ֣ר יִסְּרַ֣נִּי לֹ֣א נְתָנָֽנִי׃ וְ֝לַמָּ֗וֶת
verses.transliteration: yāh yas·sōr yis·sə·ran·nî lō nə·ṯā·nā·nî wə·lam·mā·weṯ
verses.literal: The LORD disciplined me severely . . . but He has not given me over to death

verses.original: פִּתְחוּ־ לִ֥י שַׁעֲרֵי־ צֶ֑דֶק אָֽבֹא־ בָ֝ם אוֹדֶ֥ה יָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: piṯ·ḥū- lî ša·‘ă·rê- ṣe·ḏeq ’ā·ḇō- ḇām ’ō·w·ḏeh yāh
verses.literal: Open to me the gates of righteousness that I may enter . . . and give thanks to the LORD

verses.original: זֶֽה־ הַשַּׁ֥עַר לַיהוָ֑ה צַ֝דִּיקִ֗ים יָבֹ֥אוּ בֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: zeh- haš·ša·‘ar Yah·weh ṣad·dî·qîm yā·ḇō·’ū ḇōw
verses.literal: This is the gate of the LORD the righteous shall enter through it

verses.original: א֭וֹדְךָ כִּ֣י עֲנִיתָ֑נִי וַתְּהִי־ לִ֝֗י לִֽישׁוּעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·wḏ·ḵā kî ‘ă·nî·ṯā·nî wat·tə·hî- lî lî·šū·‘āh
verses.literal: I will give You thanks for You have answered me and You have become my salvation

verses.original: אֶ֭בֶן הַבּוֹנִ֑ים מָאֲס֣וּ הָ֝יְתָ֗ה לְרֹ֣אשׁ פִּנָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’e·ḇen hab·bō·w·nîm mā·’ă·sū hā·yə·ṯāh lə·rōš pin·nāh
verses.literal: The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone . . .

verses.original: מֵאֵ֣ת זֹּ֑את הָ֣יְתָה יְ֭הוָה הִ֖יא נִפְלָ֣את בְּעֵינֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: mê·’êṯ zōṯ hā·yə·ṯāh Yah·weh hî nip̄·lāṯ bə·‘ê·nê·nū
verses.literal: - This is from the LORD [and] it [is] marvelous in our eyes

verses.original: זֶה־ הַ֭יּוֹם יְהוָ֑ה עָשָׂ֣ה נָגִ֖ילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָ֣ה בֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: zeh- hay·yō·wm Yah·weh ‘ā·śāh nā·ḡî·lāh wə·niś·mə·ḥāh ḇōw
verses.literal: This is the day [that] the LORD has made we will rejoice and be glad in it

verses.original: יְ֭הוָה הוֹשִׁ֘יעָ֥ה אָנָּ֣א נָּ֑א יְ֝הוָ֗ה אָֽנָּ֥א הַצְלִ֘יחָ֥ה נָּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh hō·wō·šî·‘āh ’ān·nā nā Yah·weh ’ān·nā haṣ·lî·ḥāh nā
verses.literal: O LORD save us we pray We beseech You O LORD . . . cause us to prosper . . .

verses.original: בָּר֣וּךְ הַ֭בָּא בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה מִבֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃ בֵּ֝רַֽכְנוּכֶ֗ם
verses.transliteration: bā·rūḵ hab·bā bə·šêm Yah·weh mib·bêṯ Yah·weh bê·raḵ·nū·ḵem
verses.literal: Blessed [is] he who comes in the name of the LORD From the house of the LORD we bless you

verses.original: יְהוָה֮ אֵ֤ל׀ וַיָּ֪אֶר לָ֥נוּ אִסְרוּ־ חַ֥ג בַּעֲבֹתִ֑ים עַד־ קַ֝רְנ֗וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’êl way·yā·’er lā·nū ’is·rū- ḥaḡ ba·‘ă·ḇō·ṯîm ‘aḏ- qar·nō·wṯ ham·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: The LORD is God He has made His light to shine upon us Bind the festal sacrifice with cords to the horns of the altar

verses.original: אַתָּ֣ה אֵלִ֣י וְאוֹדֶ֑ךָּ אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י אֲרוֹמְמֶֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh ’ê·lî wə·’ō·w·ḏe·kā ’ĕ·lō·hay ’ă·rō·wm·me·kā
verses.literal: You are my God and I will give You thanks You are my God [and] I will exalt You

verses.original: הוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה כִּי־ ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י חַסְדּֽוֹ׃ לְעוֹלָ֣ם
verses.transliteration: hō·w·ḏū Yah·weh kî- ṭō·wḇ kî ḥas·dōw lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: Give thanks to the LORD for He is good - His loving devotion endures forever
